page_title: BOU 1-2 BHA | Bournemouth v Brighton 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+7' David Brooks (Bournemouth) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+6' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) for his harsh tackle.
90+6' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+3' 1 - 2 Goal! Enes Unal plays a pass to the feet of David Brooks (Bournemouth), and he shoots into the top left corner from inside the box. It's 1:2.
90+3' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Brighton have been awarded a free kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A decent cross gives Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
89' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
86' A substitution has been made. Danny Welbeck is replaced by Evan Ferguson (Brighton).

86' The corner is swung in and Evanilson (Bournemouth) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
86' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is about to take a corner kick.
85' An attempted cross from David Brooks (Bournemouth) is cleared. Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

84' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
84' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
83' A player from Bournemouth commits a rough challenge. Stuart Attwell blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Milos Kerkez.

81' Excellent touch by David Brooks (Bournemouth)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
79' Bart Verbruggen makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Evanilson (Bournemouth) after a cross from the side.
77' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
76' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Matt O'Riley (Brighton) replaces Yasin Ayari.
75' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Adam Smith and he is replaced by Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth).
75' Substitution. Justin Kluivert walks off the pitch and David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
74' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
73' A cross from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
73' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Brighton.
68' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
66' A pass from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tyler Adams walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marcos Senesi will be replaced by Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth).
64' Substitution. Joao Pedro makes way for Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
64' Here is a change. Georginio Rutter is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Simon Adingra (Brighton).
64' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
64' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
64' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

63' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Bart Verbruggen to get hold of the ball. Bournemouth win a corner.
59' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
59' Evanilson (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brighton.
58' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
53' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
50' Stuart Attwell sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
50' The Brighton players halt their celebrations as referee Stuart Attwell makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:2. He was ably assisted there by Joao Pedro.

48' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Brighton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
47' A cross into the box from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is cleared.
46' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45+3' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
45+1' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' The Bournemouth players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
44' Bournemouth score a goal, but referee Stuart Attwell has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
43' Evanilson (Bournemouth) has a goal ruled out for offside!
40' The whistle blows and Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is booked for an infringement.
39' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
38' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
35' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
34' It seemed like Yasin Ayari (Brighton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
34' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game. One of the players from Bournemouth won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Brighton in a dangerous position.
33' Igor (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bournemouth earn a free kick.
31' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) picks up a yellow card.
30' Dangerous play by Georginio Rutter (Brighton). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
29' A player from Brighton pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Bournemouth, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
25' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
25' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bournemouth was in an offside position.
23' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Brighton are awarded the free kick.
23' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after Joao Pedro (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
22' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
21' Evanilson (Bournemouth) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.

19' Well-positioned Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the left post, but Bart Verbruggen reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
19' Bournemouth work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

18' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Brighton will take a free kick.
16' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) commits a foul after dangerous play. Brighton will take a free kick near the side line.
11' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Carlos Baleba (Brighton) was too aggressive in his challenge. Free kick. Bournemouth will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
10' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals. A free kick to Bournemouth.
10' One of the players from Brighton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but Kepa Arrizabalaga punches the ball away.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

4' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Kepa Arrizabalaga, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
3' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.

2' Close! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is introduced as the referee for today's match.
